name: Drutopia Site
description: Configuration-only base feature for the Drutopia distribution: ships text formats + CKEditor 5 editors, basic/slide block content types, and additive permission grants for six site roles.
project_description: Drutopia Site is a configuration-only base feature (a "feature" module) that installs the shared authoring baseline used across the Drutopia distribution. It ships three text formats (basic_html, full_html, restricted_html) with matching CKEditor 5 editors, two block_content bundles (basic and slide) with their fields and form/view displays, an autosave_form setting, and config/actions files that additively grant permissions to six site roles (anonymous, authenticated, contributor, editor, manager). It contains no PHP src, no routes, services, or permission definitions of its own; its only PHP is a .install file with three update hooks that install/uninstall dependency modules on upgrade. It pulls in a broad authoring dependency set (Admin Toolbar with Tools and Search, Display Suite, Paragraphs, Entity Reference Revisions, Menu Admin Per Menu, Role Delegation, Autosave Form) so a Drutopia site has a consistent editorial experience.
